name: kotlin-jump
displayName: Kotlin Jump: Fast Kotlin & Android Studio Navigation
description: Fast Kotlin & Android Studio navigation. Find Usages, Go to Definition, Compose, R.string, Android Run. No JVM, no language server. The Android Studio experience inside VS Code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Navigation, Find Usages, Code Lens, folding, highlighting, and Move File work. JAR scanning, the test runner, Android Run/ADB, and Logcat are unavailable.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: All navigation features work in untrusted workspaces.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Logcat and ADB device access aren't available in VS Code for the Web.

Open this workspace in desktop VS Code, or in a GitHub Codespace, to use Logcat.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Jetpack Compose @Composable function or state API (remember, mutableStateOf, etc.)
Kotlin sealed class or sealed interface
Kotlin extension function (has receiver type, e.g. fun String.foo())
Kotlin operator function (e.g. operator fun plus())

kotlinJump.maxIndexedFiles.description: Hard cap on the number of .kt files indexed.

kotlinJump.concurrency.description: Number of files read in parallel during initial scan.

kotlinJump.parserWorkers.description: Number of Node.js worker threads used for parallel Kotlin parsing.

kotlinJump.excludeFromReferences.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns excluded from **Find All References** results. Matched files are still indexed (Go to Definition still works inside them) but are hidden from reference results.

Example:
```json
[
  "**/src/test*/**",
  "**/src/savedAndroidTest*/**",
  "**/src/sharedTest*/**",
  "**/src/debug/**/*Preview.kt"
]
```

kotlinJump.testSourceSets.markdownDescription: Path segments identifying test source sets. Used by **Go to Definition** (to skip results that come only from tests) and **Test Explorer** (to discover test functions by path). Add custom segments for unusual layouts.

kotlinJump.gradleWrapper.markdownDescription: Path to the Gradle wrapper, **relative to the detected `gradleProjectRoot`** (not the workspace folder). On Windows, `./gradlew` automatically falls back to `./gradlew.bat`. Used when running tests from the **Test Explorer**.

kotlinJump.androidVariant.markdownDescription: Android build variant used by the **Run Android App** button. Defaults to `Debug`. Set to a custom flavor variant when needed (e.g. `"ReplicaLaPresseDebug"`).

kotlinJump.androidRunEnabled.markdownDescription: Show the **$(play) Run** button in the status bar for Android/Gradle projects.

kotlinJump.androidSkipLaunch.markdownDescription: Skip the `adb shell monkey` launch step after a successful Gradle build. Useful for stub/demo projects where no real APK is installed.

kotlinJump.adbPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `adb` binary. Empty falls back to `$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb` then PATH. Shared by **Run Android App** and **Logcat** so both pick the same binary.

kotlinJump.logcat.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the **Logcat** panel in the bottom panel area.

kotlinJump.logcat.bufferSize.markdownDescription: Maximum number of log entries kept in the in-memory ring buffer before older entries are evicted.

kotlinJump.logcat.autoStart.markdownDescription: Automatically start streaming after a successful **Run Android App**.

kotlinJump.logcat.statusBarPill.markdownDescription: Show the Logcat throughput pill in the status bar (left side, near **Run Android**). Hidden when no Logcat session is active. Independent of `kotlinJump.statusBarEnabled`.

kotlinJump.logcat.followAppPid.markdownDescription: Filter the stream to the PID of the most recently launched app. Re-resolves automatically when the app restarts.

kotlinJump.logcat.colorScheme.markdownDescription: Color scheme for log levels: `studio` mirrors Android Studio Dolphin, `monochrome` removes per-level tints, `high-contrast` increases level contrast.

name.description: Display name shown in the QuickPick (e.g. "Replica")

module.description: Gradle module path relative to the project root (e.g. "replica/app")

variant.description: Build variant override (e.g. "ReplicaLaPresseDebug"). Falls back to kotlinJump.androidVariant when omitted.

kotlinJump.androidProjects.markdownDescription:
Explicit Android app definitions. When this list contains entries, **automatic detection is skipped entirely**. The button uses these entries directly.

Equivalent to the zshrc aliases `replica()`/`rubicon()`.

```json
"kotlinJump.androidProjects": [
  {
    "name": "Rubicon",
    "module": "rubicon/app",
    "package": "ca.lapresse.android.lapressemobile.debug",
    "variant": "Debug"
  },
  {
    "name": "Replica",
    "module": "replica/app",
    "package": "ca.lapresse.lapresseplus.debug",
    "variant": "ReplicaLaPresseDebug"
  }
]
```

kotlinJump.gradleProjectRoot.markdownDescription:
Explicit path to the Gradle project root (the directory containing `settings.gradle.kts` or `settings.gradle`). **Absolute** or **relative to the workspace**.

Overrides automatic detection entirely when set. **Set this** if you opened a submodule (e.g. `app/`) instead of the project root, or if you have an unconventional layout (e.g. `master/` flat layout).

Examples:
```json
"kotlinJump.gradleProjectRoot": "test/kotlin-jump-demo"
"kotlinJump.gradleProjectRoot": "/Users/me/code/my-app"
"kotlinJump.gradleProjectRoot": "master"
```

Leave empty (default) to use automatic detection:
1. Walks up from the active editor's file (stops at the first `settings.gradle*`; matches Gradle's own root discovery rule)
2. Checks workspace folder roots
3. Scans up to 2 levels deep (handles monorepos like `kotlin-nav/test/kotlin-jump-demo`)

Run **Kotlin Jump: Diagnose Gradle Detection** to see which tier resolved the project.

kotlinJump.testTaskOverrides.markdownDescription:
Override the Gradle test task per module. Use this when a module has multiple product flavors and `testDebugUnitTest` is ambiguous.

Example:
```json
{
  ":replica:app": "testReplicaLaPresseDebugUnitTest"
}
```

In a multi-root workspace, set this in each folder's own `.vscode/settings.json` (not the top-level `settings` block of a `.code-workspace` file, which is shared by every folder).

kotlinJump.injectTestLogging.markdownDescription: Inject a Gradle init script that enables `testLogging` (passed/failed/skipped events) on all test tasks. Gives live test names in the output panel even when the project doesn't configure `testLogging` itself. Disable if your project already configures it or if the init script causes issues.

kotlinJump.testCodeLens.markdownDescription: Show **▶ Run** and **⏱ Debug** lenses above `@Test` methods and **▶ Run All** above test classes.

kotlinJump.smartNavigation.markdownDescription: When enabled, **Cmd+Click** on a declaration opens the custom Find Usages panel instead of VS Code's native References. Default: off (uses native VS Code References).

kotlinJump.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show **usages** and **implementations** counts inline above class and function declarations.

kotlinJump.semanticHighlighting.markdownDescription: Enable semantic token highlighting for Kotlin files (classes, functions, suspend, @Composable, etc.).

kotlinJump.maxReferences.markdownDescription: Maximum number of results returned by **Find Usages** and **Find All References**. Increase for completeness on large repos, decrease to keep scans fast.

kotlinJump.hoverEnabled.markdownDescription: Show hover tooltips with signature, KDoc, and type info. Disable if another extension (e.g. the JetBrains Kotlin LSP) already provides hover.

kotlinJump.fileSizeLimit.markdownDescription: Maximum file size in KB before a file is skipped during indexing. Increase to index large generated files; decrease to speed up scanning.

kotlinJump.snapshotEnabled.markdownDescription: Persist the symbol index to disk between sessions. Disable if the snapshot becomes stale or causes unexpected navigation results. The index will be rebuilt from scratch on every open.

kotlinJump.watcherDebounceMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after a file change before reindexing it. Increase on slow machines or network drives to reduce churn; decrease for almost instant updates on fast SSDs.

kotlinJump.statusBarEnabled.markdownDescription: Show the Kotlin Jump status bar item (symbol count and indexing progress) in the bottom bar.

enumDescriptions: Detect the JetBrains Kotlin LSP automatically and enable companion mode when found.
Always run as a companion. Disable hover, outline, rename, and semantic tokens regardless of other extensions.
Never enable companion mode. Register all providers.
kotlinJump.companionMode.markdownDescription:
Controls how Kotlin Jump coexists with a full Kotlin language server such as the JetBrains Kotlin LSP.

When companion mode is active, Kotlin Jump disables overlapping providers (hover, document outline, rename, semantic tokens) and keeps only the fast navigation providers (Go to Definition, Find Usages, Go to Implementation, Type/Call Hierarchy, Code Lens).

- `auto`: detect the JetBrains Kotlin LSP and enable automatically
- `always`: always enable, useful with other LSPs that provide hover and outline
- `never`: disable, register all providers

kotlinJump.workspaceSymbolKinds.markdownDescription:
Restrict **Go to Symbol in Workspace** (Cmd+T) to specific symbol kinds. Empty array shows all kinds.

Example (classes and functions only):
```json
["class", "dataClass", "sealedClass", "fun", "composable"]
```

kotlinJump.organizeImports.removeUnused.markdownDescription:
Remove unused imports when running **Organize Imports** (`Shift+Alt+O`).

Uses a heuristic: if the imported simple name (or alias) does not appear as a word in the file, the import is removed. Wildcard imports are always kept.

**To run automatically on save**, add to your `settings.json`:
```json
"editor.codeActionsOnSave": { "source.organizeImports": "explicit" }
```

kotlinJump.indexSourcesJars.markdownDescription: Index Kotlin/Java sources from `-sources.jar` files in the Gradle cache. Enables KDoc and Go to Definition for library symbols (Compose, Coroutines, AndroidX…).

kotlinJump.sourcesJarsMaxCount.markdownDescription: Maximum number of `-sources.jar` files to index from the Gradle cache. When the cap is hit, JARs are prioritised by modification time (recently downloaded first) so the current workspace's dependencies win over stale residue from older projects.

kotlinJump.gradleCacheDir.markdownDescription: Override the Gradle cache path. Leave empty to detect `~/.gradle/caches/modules-2/files-2.1` automatically.

kotlinJump.indexMavenSources.markdownDescription: Index Kotlin/Java sources from `-sources.jar` files in the Maven local repository (`~/.m2/repository`). Enables KDoc and Go to Definition for Maven-managed library symbols.

kotlinJump.mavenSourcesMaxCount.markdownDescription: Maximum number of `-sources.jar` files to index from the Maven local repository. When the cap is hit, JARs are prioritised by modification time (recently downloaded first).

kotlinJump.mavenLocalRepoDir.markdownDescription: Override the Maven local repository path. Leave empty to detect `~/.m2/repository` automatically.

kotlinJump.jdkHome.markdownDescription: Override the JDK home for source indexing (`java.lang.*`, `java.util.*`, etc.). Leave empty to detect automatically via the `JAVA_HOME` environment variable, then platform defaults (macOS `/usr/libexec/java_home`, Linux `update-alternatives`, Windows `C:\Program Files\Java\` and `C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\`). The directory must contain `lib/src.zip` (standard in OpenJDK 9+).

kotlinJump.useBundledStdlib.markdownDescription: Load the bundled Kotlin stdlib sources JAR (~600 KB shipped with the extension) so `List`, `String`, `Sequence`, etc. are navigable from the first second. No Gradle build required. A project specific stdlib version (from Gradle/Maven cache) takes precedence when present.

kotlinJump.suppressFirstScanPrompt.markdownDescription: If `true`, suppress the prompt that offers to download missing library sources after the first scan. Set automatically by clicking 'Don't show again' on the prompt.

kotlinJump.fallbackToOnlineDocs.markdownDescription: When a symbol can't be resolved locally, open the corresponding online documentation page (kotlinlang.org/api, javadoc.io, etc.) in the system browser. Off by default since it opens external tabs.

kotlinJump.useGradleTooling.markdownDescription: Use the Gradle Tooling API (`./gradlew`) to resolve the exact source JARs for the current project instead of scanning the full Gradle cache. Slower on first run but indexes only relevant dependencies. Requires `gradlew` in the workspace root.

kotlinJump.gradleToolingTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout in milliseconds for the Gradle Tooling API invocation (`kotlinJump.useGradleTooling`). Default: 30 000 ms.

kotlinJump.autoImport.enabled.markdownDescription: Show **Add import** quickfix suggestions when the cursor is on an unresolved type name. Candidates are drawn from the symbol index. No JVM required.

kotlinJump.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter name hints inline at call sites (e.g. `modifier: m`). Click any hint to jump to the parameter declaration.

kotlinJump.inlayHints.inferredTypes.markdownDescription: Show inferred return type hints on untyped `val`/`var` declarations (e.g. `val users = fetchUsers()` → `: List<User>`). Double-click to insert the explicit type.

kotlinJump.signatureHelp.markdownDescription: Show function signature popup when typing `(` or `,` inside a call, with the active parameter highlighted. Disable if another extension already provides signature help.

kotlinJump.foldingEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable folding that follows Kotlin symbols (classes, functions, import block, KDoc). More accurate than VS Code's default folding, which uses indentation alone.

kotlinJump.stringResourceFolding.markdownDescription: Visually replace `R.string.foo` references with their actual string values (like Android Studio's Resource Value Folding). The real code reappears while your cursor is on the line.

kotlinJump.colorResourceFolding.markdownDescription: Show inline swatches and resolved values for `R.color.foo` references, similar to Android Studio's resource color previews.

kotlinJump.constValFolding.markdownDescription: Inline the literal value of referenced `const val` symbols so Kotlin code rich in constants stays readable without jumping to declarations.

kotlinJump.nullAssertionHighlight.markdownDescription: Highlight `!!` not null assertions in amber/orange to make unsafe force unwraps visually distinct.

kotlinJump.todoExpiry.markdownDescription: Highlight dated TODO comments in red once the date has passed, like `// TODO(2025-01-01): migrate`. Future dates and undated TODOs keep their normal appearance.

kotlinJump.composeAccessibilityHints.markdownDescription: Show inline accessibility nudges in Compose code: `contentDescription = null` gets a decorative check, `Modifier.clickable` without a role gets a role reminder.

kotlinJump.flowChainBadges.markdownDescription: Number the stages of multi-line Flow and collection pipelines with inline badges (① ② ③) so long chains are scannable at a glance.

kotlinJump.literalTooltips.markdownDescription: Translate cron expressions and ISO 8601 durations in string literals to plain language, like `"0 */6 * * *"` showing `every 6 hours`.

kotlinJump.gradleTaskLens.markdownDescription: Show a Run task lens on task declarations in `build.gradle.kts`. Click runs the task in the integrated terminal with the module path resolved, like `./gradlew :app:generateProtos`. Desktop only.

kotlinJump.kmpTargetBadges.markdownDescription: Show target coverage badges on `expect` declarations in Kotlin Multiplatform projects, like `[android ✓] [ios ✓] [js ✗]`. Click jumps to the actual implementation.

kotlinJump.dataClassFieldWarnings.markdownDescription: Warn on `val`/`var` declared in a data class body: those fields are silently excluded from the generated `equals()`, `hashCode()`, and `copy()`.

kotlinJump.manifestPermissionBadges.markdownDescription: Show a risk pill on every `<uses-permission>` line in AndroidManifest.xml: green for normal, amber for dangerous, red for special or signature.

kotlinJump.hexColorSwatch.markdownDescription: Show a colored `■` swatch inline before hex color literals (`0xAARRGGBB` and `"#RRGGBB"` strings).

kotlinJump.drawableThumbnails.markdownDescription: Paint a miniature of the referenced Android asset in the gutter next to every `R.drawable.xxx` / `R.mipmap.xxx` call. Matches the Android Studio thumbnail behaviour.

kotlinJump.vectorPreview.autoOpen.markdownDescription: Automatically open a rendered preview of `<vector>` drawables alongside the source XML when it becomes the active editor. Reopen via *Kotlin Jump: Show Vector Preview* if dismissed.

kotlinJump.overrideGutterIcons.markdownDescription: Show override and implementation gutter lenses above interface members, abstract declarations, and overrides.

kotlinJump.sealedWhenCoverage.markdownDescription: Show a coverage CodeLens above `when (subject)` expressions over sealed class/interface subtypes and enum entries (`✓ 3/3 branches`, `⚠ 2/3 branches, missing: Error`). Click an incomplete lens to insert the missing branches.

kotlinJump.suspendCallMarkers.markdownDescription: Show inline coroutine annotations: ⚡ on every call that resolves to a `suspend` function, plus 🧵 IO / 🖥 Main / ⚙ Default / 🔀 Unconfined badges on `withContext(Dispatchers.X)`, `launch(Dispatchers.X)`, `async(Dispatchers.X)`, `flowOn(Dispatchers.X)`, `produce(...)`, and `actor(...)`. Turn this off to hide both the markers and the badges.

kotlinJump.resourceDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Report diagnostics for unresolved Android string and color resources indexed from XML files.

kotlinJump.versionCatalogHover.markdownDescription: Show hover details for `libs.xxx` references by resolving entries from `gradle/libs.versions.toml`.

kotlinJump.apiLevelInlayHints.markdownDescription: Show inlay hints with the Android version name next to `@RequiresApi` annotations and `SDK_INT` comparisons.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Kotlin Jump
walkthroughs.description: Fast Kotlin & Android Studio navigation. No JVM, no language server required.

steps.title: Navigate Kotlin instantly
steps.description: Kotlin Jump indexes your entire project in milliseconds. The parser is **109× faster** than any JVM or tree-sitter alternative. No setup, no waiting.

steps.title: Run Android in one click
steps.description:
The **$(play) Run** button builds, installs, and launches your app. No terminal required.

**WiFi setup (do once):**
1. Phone: Settings → Developer options → **Wireless debugging** ON
2. Click **$(add) Pair new device via WiFi…** below
3. Phone: **Pair device with pairing code** → enter the 6-digit code
4. Done. Connect wirelessly from now on.

[Run Android](command:kotlin-jump.runAndroid) · [Pair via WiFi](command:kotlin-jump.pairAdbWifi) · [Connect via WiFi](command:kotlin-jump.connectAdbWifi)

steps.title: Go to Definition, even inside JARs
steps.description:
Press **F12** (or **Cmd+Click**) on any symbol to jump to its definition: across files, modules, and into JAR sources. No language server, no JVM startup.

[Try it](command:editor.action.revealDefinition)

steps.title: Navigate into your dependencies
steps.description:
Kotlin Jump indexes the **JDK** (`java.lang.*`, `java.util.*`) + a bundled **Kotlin stdlib** out of the box. For Compose, Coroutines, AndroidX and other libraries, click the **`$(library)`** item in the status bar to download `-sources.jar` files via direct HTTP. No JVM, no Gradle invocation, no terminal. One click.

Hovering any library symbol also shows its KDoc inline, no file open needed.

[Open Library Sources actions](command:kotlin-jump.sources.openActions)

steps.title: Find Usages
steps.description:
Press **Alt+F7** on any symbol to open a dedicated panel showing every usage across your project. Filter out test files or Compose previews in one click.

[Open Find Usages](command:kotlin-jump.findUsages)

media.altText: Find Usages panel with test filter toggle

steps.title: Usage counts, always visible
steps.description: See **N usages | M implementations** inline above every class and function. No hover required. Click any lens to open the Find Usages panel directly.

steps.title: Toggle test and implementation (Alt+Shift+T)
steps.description:
Press **Alt+Shift+T** to instantly toggle between a class and its test file. Kotlin Jump infers the pairing from your Gradle source sets.

[Try it](command:kotlin-jump.goToTest)

steps.title: Navigate back, caret preserved
steps.description:
Press **Cmd+Alt+←** to step back through every jump. Kotlin Jump restores the **line AND column**. VS Code's native back only restores the file. Works across files, packages, and module boundaries.

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Cmd+Alt+←` | Navigate Back |
| `Cmd+Alt+→` | Navigate Forward |

steps.title: See your string values inline
steps.description:
String resource folding replaces `R.string.button_ok` with its actual value, **"OK"**, directly in the editor. Zero context switching to `strings.xml`.

Hover any `R.string.*` reference to see every locale side by side.

[Enable String Folding](command:kotlinJump.enableStringFolding)

steps.title: Vector drawables, rendered live
steps.description:
Open any `<vector>` XML drawable and a side by side preview opens automatically. Hover any `R.drawable.*` reference for an inline thumbnail. The gutter shows a mini render next to every reference. Click the CodeLens above the XML to open the dedicated panel.

[Show Vector Preview](command:kotlinJump.vectorPreview.show)

media.altText: Vector drawable preview with side by side panel and gutter thumbnails

steps.title: Inline type hints with KDoc on hover
steps.description: The `: Pokemon` is the type, rendered inline, no explicit annotation. Hover any hint and the full class KDoc appears at the call site. No jump, no file tree hunt. Parameter names at call sites work the same way (configurable per setting). Suspend calls and dispatcher hops are marked inline the same way (⚡, 🧵 IO, 🖥 Main).

media.altText: Inlay hints showing parameter names and types

steps.title: Query your codebase in natural language
steps.description:
Type **@kotlin-jump** in Copilot Chat to search your symbol index: find classes, trace usages, explore implementations, read KDoc.

[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

media.altText: AI assistant querying the symbol index
